name: deed.page API
description: Static hosting API that publishes an HTML file, a folder or a tarball to a permanent https://<slug>.deed.page URL with one PUT or POST request.
notes: The first publish needs no account or key and returns a Bearer token for later updates; CORS is open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). It ships an OpenAPI 3.1 file, llms.txt and a remote MCP server (https://deed.page/mcp), so AI agents can publish pages they generate. Free plan: 25 sites, 25 MB each.
